title: Final Photon Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the photon energy E_gamma must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Energy Limit Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The evaluation of the photon energy in the limit m_L << m_H must be correctly performed.

title: Spectral Regime Identification
description: Important Criteria: The identification of the spectral regime for the emitted photons must be accurate based on the calculated energy.

title: Lifetime Impact Discussion
description: Important Criteria: A qualitative discussion on how a shorter lifetime of heavy neutrinos affects the detection of photons must be provided.

title: Monoenergetic Justification
description: Essential Criteria: The justification that the photons produced are monoenergetic must be clearly stated.

title: Unit Consistency Check
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistently used throughout the calculations and final answers.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or missing factors in the energy expression must be avoided.
